Your privacy.

You prepare your project. Your information stays on your device.

Your project summary

The contact form does not send its contents to a server or store any data in an account, a cookie or the browser’s local storage. The information you enter stays in memory while the page is open. Reloading the page clears it.

Downloading and copying

The download button creates a text file on your device. At your request, the copy button places the summary on your clipboard. Neither action sends the summary to the company.

Opening a text message

If you choose “Open in messaging app”, your device passes the text to a compatible messaging app. You check the contents and decide whether to send it to 06 47 74 23 33. Sending depends on your mobile plan and provider.

Cookies and analytics

This version does not include advertising cookies, analytics trackers, embedded maps or fonts loaded from an external service. Images and fonts are served with the website.

External links and hosting

The map link opens Google Maps only when you choose to use it. The hosting service may process technical information needed to access the website; its terms will depend on the hosting selected for the public launch.

Contact us

For any questions about this information, contact the company on 06 47 74 23 33 or at its address: 896 rue de l’Oudar, 01170 Gex, France.
